# fma-ui

> A personal component registry in the shadcn/ui format, built on react-aria-components: components, blocks, libs, hooks and themes copied into your project by the shadcn CLI (not an npm package).

Register the namespace in components.json:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@fma-ui": "https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Then add items by name: `npx shadcn@latest add @fma-ui/button`. Dependencies between items resolve through the same namespace. Everything installs into `fma-ui` folders (`components/fma-ui/`, `hooks/fma-ui/`, `lib/fma-ui/`), so it never collides with the official shadcn components.

The APIs follow React Aria, not Radix: `isDisabled` instead of `disabled`, `onPress` instead of `onClick`, and no `asChild` (use `LinkButton` for a link that looks like a button). Wrap the app in React Aria's `RouterProvider` for client-side links.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/docs): Installation, React Aria conventions, themes.
- [Registry index](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/registry.json): Every component, block, lib, hook and theme in one file.
- [Theme editor](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/themes): Tweak a theme and export it as CSS or JSON.
- [Full text](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/llms-full.txt): This file plus every item's usage example.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/accordion): A vertically stacked set of headers that expand to reveal or hide associated content. Supports single or multiple items open at once. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/accordion.json
- [Alert](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/alert): A callout for important, static information — supports an icon, title, description, and an optional action, with semantic variants (destructive/info/success/warning/invert). Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/alert.json
- [Alert Dialog](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/alert-dialog): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects an explicit response (e.g. confirming a destructive action) — unlike Dialog, it can't be dismissed by clicking outside or pressing Escape. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/alert-dialog.json
- [Aspect Ratio](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/aspect-ratio): Constrains content (typically an image or video) to a fixed width/height ratio, so it scales without distortion or layout shift. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/aspect-ratio.json
- [Attachment](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/attachment): A file/attachment chip for chat-style UIs — shows a name, optional upload progress or error state, and an independently clickable remove action. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/attachment.json
- [Avatar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/avatar): A user/entity image with a text or icon fallback for when the image fails to load. Composes into overlapping groups for showing multiple participants. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/avatar.json
- [Badge](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/badge): A small label for status, count, or category — inline with text or attached to another element. Semantic variants (info/success/warning/destructive/invert) in solid, light and outline styles, plus size and radius options. Can also render as a link. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/badge.json
- [Breadcrumb](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/breadcrumb): Shows the user's current location within a hierarchy, as a trail of links back to parent pages, with an ellipsis for collapsing long paths. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/breadcrumb.json
- [Bubble](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/bubble): A single chat message bubble — start/end alignment for sent vs. received, several color variants, and an optional reactions pill overlaid on a corner. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/bubble.json
- [Button](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/button): Displays a button, or a component that looks like one, with a set of visual variants and sizes. Also exports LinkButton (react-aria-components' Link, same variants) for link-as-button use cases. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/button.json
- [Button Group](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/button-group): Visually joins a row (or column) of buttons into one connected control, with shared borders and rounded end corners. Can include a separator or a plain text segment. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/button-group.json
- [Calendar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/calendar): A date grid for selecting a single date, multiple dates or a range. The header opens month and year grids for fast navigation, and `granularity` switches the selection to whole months or years. `unavailableRanges` blocks booked spans, and an already-selected value that becomes blocked travels to the nearest available date. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/calendar.json
- [Card](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/card): A container for grouping related content, with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots. Supports a compact size="sm" variant. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/card.json
- [Carousel](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/carousel): A carousel for cycling through slides (images, cards, or any content) with keyboard, swipe, and button navigation. Built on embla-carousel-react; CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext are Buttons wired to the carousel API. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/carousel.json
- [Chart](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/chart): Composable chart primitives (ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartLegend) wrapping Recharts, themed via CSS custom properties from a ChartConfig. Supports area, bar, line, and pie charts. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/chart.json
- [Checkbox](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/checkbox): A control for a single on/off/indeterminate value. Pair with an external Label (via id/htmlFor) laid out as a flex row rather than passing label text as children. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/checkbox.json
- [Collapsible](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/collapsible): Shows or hides a single section of content behind a trigger. A thin wrapper around react-aria-components' Disclosure — for several mutually-exclusive sections, use Accordion instead. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/collapsible.json
- [Color Picker](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/color-picker): An OKLCH color picker: lightness, chroma and hue sliders painted with the color's own gradients. Given a background (contrastWith), it shows the WCAG ratio, hatches the lightness that fails AA, marks the AA/AAA thresholds and offers "Fix to AA/AAA" buttons that jump to the nearest passing lightness keeping the hue. A grid of preset swatches (Tailwind's palette by default, or your own via swatches) sets the color in one click, hatching the presets that fail AA. ColorPicker is a swatch that opens it in a popover; ColorPickerPanel renders it inline. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/color-picker.json
- [Combobox](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/combobox): A searchable, filterable select combining a text input with a listbox popover. Supports single selection (ComboboxValue) or a multi-select tag/chip input (ComboboxChips + ComboboxChip). Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/combobox.json
- [Command](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/command): A searchable list of commands or actions, filtered live as you type. Export CommandDialog wraps it in a Dialog for a full command-palette (⌘K) pattern. Pass `CommandEmpty` through `CommandList`'s `renderEmptyState`, not as a child: the list only accepts items, groups and separators. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/command.json
- [Context Menu](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/context-menu): A menu that opens on right-click (or long-press on touch) instead of a regular trigger click. Supports nested submenus, separators, and keyboard shortcut display. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/context-menu.json
- [Data Grid](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/data-grid): A data grid driven by a TanStack Table v9 instance and rendered with react-aria's `Table`, which brings cell keyboard navigation, `aria-sort`, selection, column resizing, row drag and drop and virtualization. Create the table with `useTable({ features: dataGridFeatures, ... })`: the exported features cover sorting, filtering with facets, pagination, selection, row expanding, row and column pinning, ordering, visibility and sizing, with client-side row models; for server-side data (or to show every row) set `manualSorting`/`manualFiltering`/`manualPagination`. Column `meta` takes `headerTitle`, `skeleton`, `autoSize`, `headerClassName` and `cellClassName`. Wrap parts in `DataGrid table={table} recordCount={…}`: `DataGridTable`, `DataGridPagination`, `DataGridColumnHeader` (sort indicator, plus a menu for pinning, moving and visibility when `tableLayout` enables them), `DataGridColumnVisibility`, `DataGridColumnFilter` (faceted, use `filterFn: "arrHas"`), `DataGridRowSelect` (with `enableRowSelection`), `DataGridRowPin`, `DataGridRowDragHandle` (with `onRowsReorder`) and `DataGridRowExpand` (with `getRowCanExpand` and `DataGridTable`'s `renderExpandedRow`, a full-width details row). `tableLayout.columnsDraggable` lets users drag headers to reorder columns (keyboard users use the header menu's move actions). `isLoading` shows skeleton rows (`meta.skeleton`) or a spinner; `meta.autoSize` columns take the remaining width (not measured from content). Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/data-grid.json
- [Date Field](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/date-field): A segmented, keyboard-editable date input. `granularity` also accepts "month" and "year" for month- or year-only fields. Values blocked by `minValue`/`maxValue` or `unavailableRanges` move to the nearest available date once the field loses focus, so typing is never interrupted. Exports `DateInput` for composing date pickers. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/date-field.json
- [Date Picker](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/date-picker): A typed date input paired with a calendar popover over one value, for single dates (`DatePicker`) or ranges (`DateRangePicker`). Supports month- and year-only granularity, `unavailableRanges`, and a non-modal popover: the input stays editable while the calendar is open, and the calendar follows what is typed. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/date-picker.json
- [Dialog](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/dialog): A modal window layered over the page, requiring explicit action (or Escape) to dismiss. Pair with react-aria-components' DialogTrigger to wire up the trigger and open state. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/dialog.json
- [Direction](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/direction): Sets LTR/RTL text-direction context for descendant react-aria-components — a compatibility shim so a Radix/Base UI-style `direction` prop keeps working via react-aria's locale system. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/direction.json
- [Drawer](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/drawer): A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, with swipe-to-dismiss and snap-point support. Uses @base-ui/react (not react-aria-components), so its API and data attributes differ from this repo's other overlays. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/drawer.json
- [Dropdown Menu](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/dropdown-menu): A menu of actions or options triggered by clicking a button. Supports nested submenus, separators, labels, and a shortcut-display slot for each item. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/dropdown-menu.json
- [Empty](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/empty): A placeholder for empty states — no data, no search results, nothing configured yet. Composes an icon/media, title, description, and optional call-to-action content. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/empty.json
- [Field](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/field): Layout primitives for building form fields: Field, FieldSet/FieldLegend for grouping, FieldLabel/FieldDescription/FieldError for the usual label+hint+error stack, and FieldSeparator for splitting a group. Pairs with Label, Input, and friends. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/field.json
- [Hover Card](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/hover-card): A popover that shows on hover or focus instead of click, for previewing content (a profile card, a link preview) without navigating away. Unlike a tooltip, it can contain interactive content. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/hover-card.json
- [Icon Stack](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/icon-stack): A layered icon illustration for empty states: three receding cards drawn from `currentColor`, with an optional glyph (`children`) laid flat on the front card. Pairs with `EmptyMedia`. Decorative: the SVG is hidden from assistive tech, so give the glyph `aria-hidden` too. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/icon-stack.json
- [Icon Tile](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/icon-tile): A square surface that gives icons a consistent footprint. `variant`: `outline` (bordered), `elevated` (raised chip), `soft` (tinted double container), `solid` (filled) or `frame` (double container matching `Card`); `soft` and `solid` follow `currentColor`, so a text color class retints them. `size` goes from `xs` to `xl`; `radius` is `default` (clamped to the tile) or `full` (circular). Renders a `<span>`; wrap it in a `Button` or `Link` to make it interactive. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/icon-tile.json
- [Input](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/input): A single-line text input, styled to match the rest of the registry. Plain native attributes (disabled, not isDisabled) since it wraps react-aria-components' bare Input rather than a higher-level field primitive. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/input.json
- [Input Group](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/input-group): Wraps an Input or Textarea with leading/trailing addons (icons, text, or buttons) inside one bordered container, so the whole group shares a single focus ring and border. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/input-group.json
- [Input Otp](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/input-otp): A one-time-password / verification-code input rendered as individual boxed slots, backed by a single hidden text input for real typing, paste, and autofill behavior. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/input-otp.json
- [Item](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/item): A generic row layout for lists of things — media/icon, title, description, and trailing actions — that renders as a <div> or, when given an href, a real link. Use ItemGroup to stack several with consistent spacing. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/item.json
- [Kbd](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/kbd): Displays a keyboard key or shortcut (e.g. ⌘K) inline, styled as a small pill. KbdGroup lays out several keys side by side for combos like ⌘+Shift+P. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/kbd.json
- [Label](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/label): A form field label. Pair it with a control via id/htmlFor rather than passing label text as the control's own children — several toggle-style primitives (Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroupItem) render their children inside a small fixed-size box meant for a custom indicator, not prose. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/label.json
- [Marker](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/marker): A small inline label used in chat/message timelines — a date separator, a status note, or similar metadata — rendered in muted text with an optional icon. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/marker.json
- [Masked Input](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/masked-input): An `Input` with live Maskito formatting. `mask` takes a preset name ("cpf", "cnpj", "cpf-cnpj", "cep", "phone", "credit-card", "date", "time", "date-time", "date-range", "decimal"), a parameterized preset such as `{ type: "decimal", prefix: "R$ " }` (safe to write inline), or custom Maskito options. Presets set `inputMode`, `autoComplete` and a placeholder. `onValueChange` receives the raw value (digits, ISO date, dot-decimal) and the masked text; `value` may be either, so a form can store only the raw value. Works inside a react-aria `TextField`. For other inputs, such as `InputGroupInput`, spread `useMask(...).inputProps` instead. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/masked-input.json
- [Menubar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/menubar): An app-style menu bar (File, Edit, View…). `Menubar` is a react-aria `Toolbar`, so arrow keys move between menus; each `MenubarMenu` pairs a `MenubarTrigger` with a `MenubarContent` built on `DropdownMenu`, including submenus (`MenubarSub`). Checkbox- and radio-like items come from react-aria selection: give a `MenubarGroup` `selectionMode` ("multiple" or "single") and `selectedKeys`/`onSelectionChange`, and its items show a check when selected. Menus open on press or Enter/Space/ArrowDown; while one is open, hovering another trigger or pressing ArrowLeft/ArrowRight opens the neighbouring menu. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/menubar.json
- [Message](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/message): Layout for one message row in a chat UI — avatar, header, footer, and a content column that aligns to the start or end depending on who sent it. Pairs with Bubble for the actual message content. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/message.json
- [Message Scroller](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/message-scroller): An auto-scrolling viewport for chat message lists: sticks to the latest message as new ones arrive, and shows a jump-to-end/start button once the user scrolls away. Experimental: it doesn't sit on react-aria-components like the rest of this registry, and @shadcn/react is still pre-1.0. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/message-scroller.json
- [Native Select](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/native-select): A styled wrapper around the real, native <select> — use it when you need actual native select behavior (mobile OS pickers, form autofill, no JS dependency) instead of react-aria-components' custom Select. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/native-select.json
- [Navigation Menu](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/navigation-menu): Site-header navigation: a `<nav>` list of top-level links and disclosure dropdowns. A `NavigationMenuItem` holds either a `NavigationMenuLink` or a `NavigationMenuTrigger` (a button with `aria-expanded`) plus its `NavigationMenuContent` (a popover). Escape or a click outside closes the dropdown and returns focus to the trigger; following a link closes it too. Style plain links like triggers with `navigationMenuTriggerStyle()`, and mark the current page with `aria-current="page"`. Dropdowns open on press; with `openOnHover` they also open when the pointer rests on a trigger (`delay`, `closeDelay`), as a non-modal "peek" that leaves focus alone, switches at once to another trigger and closes when the pointer leaves or on Escape. Pressing a peeked trigger keeps it open as a regular dropdown. Add `NavigationMenuIndicator` after the list for an arrow that slides under the open trigger. For app command menus use `Menubar` or `DropdownMenu`. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/navigation-menu.json
- [Pagination](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/pagination): Page-number navigation built from LinkButton — previous/next controls, numbered links, and an ellipsis for collapsed ranges. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/pagination.json
- [Popover](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/popover): A non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger — for supplementary controls or content (e.g. a settings form) that shouldn't block the rest of the page. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/popover.json
- [Progress](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/progress): A horizontal progress bar communicating the completion of a task, determinate or indeterminate, with optional label/value slots. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/progress.json
- [Questionnaire](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/questionnaire): A multi-step form/survey block (progress, choices, text input, previous/skip/next/submit) for chat-kit style conversational flows. Built on @shadcn/react, not react-aria-components — upstream hasn't ported it to the aria base yet. Experimental while @shadcn/react is pre-1.0. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/questionnaire.json
- [Radio Group](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/radio-group): A set of mutually-exclusive radio options. Pair each RadioGroupItem with an external Label via id/htmlFor — its own children slot is for a custom indicator, not label text. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/radio-group.json
- [Resizable](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/resizable): Resizable split panes (panel group, panel, drag handle) built on react-resizable-panels — for layouts like a sidebar/editor split the user can drag to resize. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/resizable.json
- [Scroll Area](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/scroll-area): A scrollable container with a themeable, always-consistent-looking scrollbar via native scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color — no JS scrollbar emulation. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/scroll-area.json
- [Select](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/select): A listbox-style picker (react-aria-components' Select) with a trigger, popover, groups, and an optional search input — richer than the native <select> (see native-select for that). Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/select.json
- [Separator](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/separator): A thin visual divider between content, horizontal or vertical. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/separator.json
- [Sheet](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/sheet): A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (top/right/bottom/left) — for navigation drawers, filters, or forms that need more room than a popover. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/sheet.json
- [Sidebar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/sidebar): A collapsible application sidebar with a mobile drawer fallback, a Cmd/Ctrl+B keyboard shortcut, and composable header/content/footer/menu slots. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/sidebar.json
- [Simple Time Picker](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/simple-time-picker): A button showing a time that opens a popover with columns for hours, minutes, seconds and AM/PM. Values are `@internationalized/date` `Time` objects (`value`/`defaultValue`/`onChange`), like the registry's DateField. `granularity` ("hour", "minute", "second"; default "minute") picks the columns and `hourCycle={12}` adds AM/PM. `minValue`/`maxValue` disable out-of-range options and clamp picks to the nearest allowed time. Each column is a react-aria `ListBox`: arrow keys and typing move within it, Tab moves between columns, Escape closes. For typed entry use `DateField` with `granularity="minute"` or react-aria's `TimeField`. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/simple-time-picker.json
- [Skeleton](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/skeleton): A pulsing placeholder block for content that's still loading — size and shape it with className to match whatever it stands in for. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/skeleton.json
- [Slider](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/slider): A draggable single- or range-value slider, horizontal or vertical — pass an array default/value to get one thumb per value. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/slider.json
- [Sonner](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/sonner): A themed wrapper around the sonner toast library. Renders the toast viewport (Toaster); call toast() from "sonner" anywhere to actually show one. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/sonner.json
- [Spinner](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/spinner): A spinning loading indicator icon (role="status"), sized via className — drop it inside a disabled button or empty state while something loads. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/spinner.json
- [Stepper](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/stepper): Multi-step navigation, horizontal or vertical, built on react-aria `Tabs`: arrow keys, Home and End move between steps and Enter or Space selects one (manual activation). `value`/`defaultValue`/`onValueChange` hold the current step. Each `StepperItem` is a tab whose `data-state` is `completed` (before the current step, or `isCompleted`), `active` or `inactive`; `isDisabled` skips it and `isLoading` shows the loading indicator. `indicators` swaps an indicator's content per state. `StepperContent` panels show the current step's content. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/stepper.json
- [Switch](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/switch): A two-state on/off toggle switch, in default and compact sizes. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/switch.json
- [Table](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/table): Semantic table primitives (header, body, rows, cells, footer, caption) built on react-aria-components' Table for accessible, sorting/selection-ready markup. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/table.json
- [Tabs](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/tabs): A tab list and its panels for switching between related views, with default and line visual variants, horizontal or vertical orientation. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/tabs.json
- [Textarea](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/textarea): A multi-line text input that auto-sizes to its content by default (field-sizing-content), rather than staying a fixed number of rows. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/textarea.json
- [Timeline](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/timeline): A vertical or horizontal timeline rendered as an ordered list. `value` is the current step: items with `step <= value` get `data-completed` (filled indicator and separator) and the current one gets `aria-current="step"`. Compose each `TimelineItem` from `TimelineHeader` (`TimelineDate`, `TimelineTitle`, `TimelineIndicator`), `TimelineSeparator` and `TimelineContent`. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/timeline.json
- [Toggle](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/toggle): A single two-state pressable button (on/off), in default/outline variants and three sizes — the single-button counterpart to ToggleGroup. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/toggle.json
- [Toggle Group](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/toggle-group): A connected row (or column) of Toggle buttons sharing one visual variant/size/spacing, for grouped single- or multi-select controls (e.g. text formatting). Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/toggle-group.json
- [Tooltip](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/components/tooltip): A short, non-interactive hint that appears on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/tooltip.json

## Blocks

- [App Sidebar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/blocks/app-sidebar): An app-shell sidebar block, collapsible to icons: a team switcher (or a static logo), one navigation section per `data.nav` entry and a user menu. Driven by an `AppSidebarData` object, so teams, sections and items are data. Items with sub-items expand inline (`variant: "collapse"`) or open a menu (`"dropdown"`, and always while collapsed to icons). Links are react-aria `Link`s: wrap the app in `RouterProvider` for client-side routing. `onTeamChange`, `onAddTeam` and `onUserAction` handle the menus. Render inside a `SidebarProvider`. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/app-sidebar.json
- [Event Calendar](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/blocks/event-calendar): A headless-first event calendar: month, week, day, N-day, agenda and resource views, recurring events (structured rules or RRULE strings), time zones, drag to move/resize and drag to create (keyboard users create through `showDayAddButton`'s per-day buttons), i18n with RTL, and a subscribable store (`useEventCalendar`, `useEventCalendarSelector`). Compose `<EventCalendar>` with `EventCalendarNav` and `EventCalendarContent`, or build your own parts from the hooks. Events are controlled (`events`/`onEventsChange`) or not (`defaultEvents`); `onEventUpdate` accepts, rejects or adjusts each drag. The nav, view switcher, date picker and "+N more" popover use the registry's react-aria Button, Tooltip, DropdownMenu, Popover and Calendar. Registry item: https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/event-calendar.json

## Themes

- [Amber Minimal](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-amber-minimal.json): Amber accents on white and near-black, Inter and tight 0.375rem corners.
- [Caffeine](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-caffeine.json): Coffee-brown primary with a latte-colored secondary; the dark mode inverts to a cream primary.
- [Catppuccin](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-catppuccin.json): Catppuccin's Latte and Mocha pastels: mauve primary, sky accent, Montserrat and Fira Code.
- [Claude](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-claude.json): Claude's warm palette: terracotta primary on cream and warm charcoal, system fonts and 0.5rem corners.
- [Clean Slate](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-clean-slate.json): Slate grays with an indigo primary, Inter and a navy dark mode.
- [Cosmic Night](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-cosmic-night.json): Lavender and indigo, with a deep navy-black dark mode and Inter.
- [Default](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-default.json): The stock fma-ui theme from styles.css: neutral grays, Geist and 0.625rem corners.
- [Elegant Luxury](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-elegant-luxury.json): Burgundy primary with cream and gold accents, Poppins and Libre Baskerville.
- [Emitte](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-emitte.json): EMITTE's brand theme: deep blue primary and sidebar, green secondary, Poppins and 0.375rem corners.
- [Graphite](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-graphite.json): Monochrome graphite grays from light to charcoal, Montserrat and soft shadows.
- [Kodama Grove](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-kodama-grove.json): Parchment and olive greens with Merriweather throughout; a warm forest dark mode.
- [Modern Minimal](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-modern-minimal.json): White surfaces with a bright blue primary, Inter and tight 0.375rem corners.
- [Mono](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-mono.json): Stark grayscale with Geist Mono everywhere and square corners.
- [Nature](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-nature.json): Forest greens over warm off-white, with Montserrat for UI and Merriweather for serif text.
- [Northern Lights](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-northern-lights.json): Aurora greens and blues on light gray with Plus Jakarta Sans; dark slate mode.
- [Ocean Breeze](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-ocean-breeze.json): Sea-green primary over a pale sky-blue background with DM Sans and Lora; navy dark mode.
- [Soft Pop](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-soft-pop.json): Indigo, teal and amber pops on a soft off-white, DM Sans and round 1rem corners.
- [Starry Night](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-starry-night.json): Deep night blue with a golden secondary and Libre Baskerville, after Van Gogh.
- [Supabase](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-supabase.json): Supabase's emerald green on near-white and near-black, Outfit with loose tracking and 0.5rem corners.
- [Vintage Paper](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-vintage-paper.json): Parchment backgrounds, brown ink and Libre Baskerville for an old-print feel.
- [Violet Bloom](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/theme-violet-bloom.json): Vivid violet primary on near-white, Plus Jakarta Sans and very round 1.4rem corners.

## Optional

- [Color Contrast](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/color-contrast.json): WCAG 2 contrast helpers over OKLCH: contrast ratio and level, the lightness ranges where a color passes against a background, and the nearest passing color that keeps its hue (nearestContrastColor). Results are oklch strings clamped to sRGB.
- [Date Availability](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/date-availability.json): Finds the nearest date that isn't blocked by min/max or unavailable ranges, and centralizes the travel-or-clear correction policy: a blocked value moves to a valid neighbour instead of being discarded, and is cleared only when no available date exists.
- [Date Fns Compat](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/date-fns-compat.json): date-fns-shaped API (addDays, format, isBefore, TZDate, ...) backed by @internationalized/date: same names and argument order as date-fns/@date-fns/tz, taking and returning plain Date (or TZDate), with DST-safe calendar arithmetic. Also exports toZoned/fromZoned for migrating call sites onto ZonedDateTime directly.
- [Date Granularity](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/date-granularity.json): Period helpers for month/year date selection: period start/end, same-period comparison, period-widened min/max bounds, and lifting a day-level isDateUnavailable predicate to whole months or years.
- [Input Masks](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/input-masks.json): Input-mask system built on Maskito: mask option hooks, formatters and remover utilities for Brazilian documents and common formats (CPF, CNPJ, CPF-or-CNPJ, CEP, phone, credit card, date, date range, date-time, time, decimal).
- [Interval Helpers](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/interval-helpers.json): Helpers for inclusive Interval<T> spans (e.g. unavailable date ranges), generic over any T with a .compare() method such as @internationalized/date's DateValue. createIsWithinAnyInterval plugs straight into react-aria's isDateUnavailable prop.
- [Type Helper](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/type-helper.json): Runtime type-checking helpers (typeHelper.isString/isNumber/isArray/...) built on Object.prototype.toString, usable as TypeScript type guards.
- [Types](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/types.json): Shared type utilities: Brand<T, B> for nominal typing of structurally-identical types, and Interval<T> for inclusive from/to spans.
- [Use Available Date Correction](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/use-available-date-correction.json): useAvailableDateCorrection: revalidates an already-committed date value against min/max/unavailable ranges whenever the value or constraints change, correcting it through the date-availability travel-or-clear policy.
- [Use Mask](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/use-mask.json): useMask: applies an input-masks preset ("cpf", "phone", { type: "decimal", prefix: "R$ " }…) or custom Maskito options to any input. Spread `inputProps` onto Input, InputGroupInput or a native input; it carries the masked value, Maskito's ref, and per-preset inputMode, autoComplete and placeholder. Reports the raw value through onValueChange, accepts a raw or masked controlled value, and reads the value of an enclosing react-aria TextField.
- [Use Mobile](https://ui.fmartinsandre.dev.br/r/use-mobile.json): useIsMobile: reports whether the viewport is below the 768px mobile breakpoint, updating on resize. Used by sidebar.
